description: Students focus on writing scientific papers, preparing scientific posters, and giving presentations in the context of a specific, year-long, interdisciplinary research project. In addition, this weekly seminar series builds collaborative research skills such as working in teams, performing reviews of math, statistics, and computer science literature, consulting effectively, and communicating proficiently. Exposure to post-graduate opportunities in statistics and data science disciplines is also provided. Open to students accepted into the Center for Interdisciplinary Research and by permission of the instructor only. This course does not count toward the SDS Major or SDS Concentration.
name: SDS Research Methods
notes: Registration by permission of instructor only.
title: Statistics and Data Science Research Methods
